item: I261 / user goal: durable unsaved drafts
scope: Synthetic editing and crash-recovery checks against an exact private copy of the current AI Work Board build; no personal journal was opened.

validation.command: TMPDIR=$HOME/tempia python3 -B tests/test_editing.py && TMPDIR=$HOME/tempia python3 -B tests/test_draft_durability.py && TMPDIR=$HOME/tempia python3 -B tests/test_conversation_draft_durability.py (private exact-build snapshot)

live_application.action: Preserved the live process and its in-memory editor state; did not terminate or relaunch it. The tested build remains at build/work-board, but the open process still uses the older executable.

build_churn_note: The main build path changed during an earlier test attempt. The final validation used an exact staged copy of the then-current e770… build; its SHA-256 matched the main path before and after the test, and make -q reported the target up to date.
result: The fast-checkpoint fix passes on the current e770… build. No duplicate demand was created. User approval and personal-draft state were not inferred. The live UI remains on the older executable and was preserved.
